name: UploadThing
summary: UploadThing is a developer-friendly file upload service that handles storage, delivery, and upload widgets so you skip managing your own bucket.

free_plan_covers.note: Free plan gives 2 GB storage shared across your apps with unlimited uploads and downloads, no user cap stated.

first_paid_usd_month.note: Cheapest paid plan is $10/month for 100 GB of storage and 30 days of audit log retention.

portability.note: Proprietary upload API, not S3-compatible, but file URLs stay stable and the UTApi lets you script an export.

direct_uploads.note: The client SDK requests a presigned URL from your server, then uploads bytes straight to storage, skipping your server.

egress_fees.note: No bandwidth or egress fee on any plan; the free plan explicitly states unlimited uploads and downloads.

setup.step: Sign up at uploadthing.com and create an app to get an API token.
Install uploadthing and the UploadThing package for your framework, for example @uploadthing/react, @uploadthing/svelte or @uploadthing/vue.
Set your UploadThing token as an environment variable.
Define a FileRouter on the server with upload rules and auth middleware, then serve it from a server route.
Add the generated UploadButton or UploadDropzone component to a page.

builder_notes: Put file size, type limits, and auth checks in the server-side FileRouter middleware, not only in the upload component on the page.
Use the prebuilt UploadButton or UploadDropzone components instead of building a custom uploader from scratch.
